Cleared 4 TS6133 build errors: prefixed unused 'dark' params with _ in StepperDemo:169 + TableDemo:533 (intentional theme-aware-via-tokens stubs); deleted dead globalSearchFilter useState in TableDemo:1461 (no consumers).

Refactored 4 setState-in-effect call sites to setState-during-render (with state-based prev/signature guards) so the new react-hooks/set-state-in-effect rule passes. Pattern: track previous prop in useState, compare during render, set both prev tracker and derived state in one batched render. The single legitimate timer-driven hide path keeps its setState inside setTimeout (allowed). Avoids ref-based prev trackers (forbidden by react-hooks/refs) and behaves identically to the original effects.
Trimmed unnecessary 'dark' deps from 4 useCallback/useMemo bodies that only consume Tailwind dark: classes (not the JS variable). Removed unused eslint-disable-next-line directive in Faq.tsx:184.

Closed 3 carried-over 320px overflow risks: IPI country trigger min-w-[110px] sm:min-w-[130px]; Table filter dropdown min-w-[160px] sm:min-w-[180px] max-w-[calc(100vw-32px)]; DatePicker year/month dropdownMenu min-w-[120px] sm:min-w-[140px]. Default still 130/180/140 at sm+ breakpoints (640px+); 320px viewport now contracts cleanly without losing affordances at desktop.

Phase A trivial fixes: wrapped MultiSelectDropdownContent in React.memo (saves re-renders when parent state changes); replaced AvatarGroup index-only fallback key with a content-aware composite (childName-index) for better identity stability; added isBrowser guard to ClockFace pointerup/pointercancel listeners (defense in depth — useEffect already client-side); Tooltip Escape handler now stopPropagation()s before close so it can't dismiss an enclosing Modal/Drawer; JSON-LD payloads in marketing sections now escape '</' to '<\/' inside JSON.stringify so a future closing-script-tag substring can't break HTML parsing.

Phase B type-safety: Modal previousActiveElement now uses instanceof HTMLElement narrowing instead of a bare cast; Stepper extracts an isExoticIconComponent type predicate so the runtime $$typeof narrowing produces a real ComponentType (single cast contained inside the predicate); AvatarGroup keyboard activation now calls e.currentTarget.click() to dispatch a real click — eliminates the KeyboardEvent→MouseEvent cast and routes through the existing onClick handler with a proper SyntheticMouseEvent; DatePicker handleClearClick + SearchableDropdown handleClear widened to React.SyntheticEvent so both onClick (MouseEvent) and onKeyDown (KeyboardEvent) call sites work without unsafe casts. TYPE-008/TYPE-009 attempted via native dispatch path (setter + dispatchEvent) but reverted because jsdom + React's _valueTracker reconciles controlled-input value back before our onChange observes it — moved to deferred with rationale.

Phase C theme: Tooltip shadow preset alphas bumped from 0.12-0.30 to 0.18-0.45 so they read on dark surfaces (the previous values were tuned for white bg); DatePicker marker tooltip inline boxShadow alpha 0.15 → 0.25 for the same reason; Table default striped row dark mode bg-white/[0.02] → bg-white/[0.04] (doubled alpha, still subtle, now actually visible). A11Y-BREADCRUMB-001 deferred — fixing requires updating 8+ test assertions on the role=menu/menuitem queries; flagged for a dedicated cycle.

Phase D doc renames: 8 placeholder COMPONENT.ai.md files renamed to <NAME>.ai.md to match the convention used by the other 22 components — DATEPICKER, DROPDOWN, INTERNATIONALPHONEINPUT, MULTISELECTDROPDOWN, MULTISELECTSEARCHABLEDROPDOWN, SEARCHABLEDROPDOWN, TABLE, TIMEPICKER. Updated 16 source-comment references (8 in each component's index.ts and main .tsx file). BrandLogo's COMPONENT.ai.md left as-is since BrandLogo isn't in the published-30 set.
